title: Resolved expected workflow checks v2
description: Generated from immutable workflow YAML by workflow-lint; runtimes read this data, never reinterpret YAML. For pull_request, match the complete PR base...head changed-file set from the paginated PR files API. Reaching GitHub's 3,000-file cap or otherwise failing to prove completeness fails closed. For merge_group, match the whole event base_sha...head_sha changed-file set, not the current PR's files. An event whose relevance cannot be represented must use paths:null (always required). Expected-but-missing names fail closed. Completeness additionally requires an unfiltered expected-checks / verify record with paths:null for both events and its successful GitHub Actions (integration 15368) check on the evaluated SHA, associated with the PR or merge group. The verifier compares canonical generated bytes at that exact checkout.

name.description: Exact literal GitHub check-run name. Required matrix/dynamic names are refused at generation. Reusable calls expand as caller / callee (and nested literal prefixes). Conditional children are represented by a required always-running aggregate.

events.description: Split a check into separate records when the events have different filters. Never apply a PR-only paths filter to an unconditional merge-group run.

paths.description: null means always required. Otherwise apply GitHub's ordered workflow paths patterns, including negative exclusions and later positive re-inclusion, to the complete changed-file set.

paths_ignore.description: null means no ignore filter. Otherwise require the check when at least one changed file is not ignored. An ignore-only YAML trigger is normalized to paths:["**"] plus paths_ignore, preserving paths:null as always required. An unknown or empty diff cannot establish irrelevance; fail closed or require the check.
